MAGNIFICO LOCAL CON MUCHAS POSIBILIDADES!
 Local situado en la calle Mercurio, cerca de la calle San Cipriano.
2 locales unidos con posibilidad de separación.
Local 1 con 240m2 útiles- Local 2 -142m2 útiles. Total: 382m2 útiles.
distribuidos en grandes estancias con ventana a las zonas comunes de la 
comunidad, no se pueden modificar el tamaño de las ventanas ni abrir puertas de acceso a las zonas comunes, instalación de climatizador por falso techo frio/calor, 4 baños, cocina amplia, 2 puertas de entrada/salida, 2ª puerta con doble puerta y telefonillo, última actividad; guardería infantil con mas de 30 años en activo. ABSTENERSE INTERESADOS EN REALIZAR VIVIENDAS.

inv.desc_en:
MAGNIFICENT PREMISES WITH MANY POSSIBILITIES!
Premises located on Mercurio Street, near San Cipriano Street.
2 units joined together with the possibility of separation.
Unit 1 with 240m2 of usable space - Unit 2 with 142m2 of usable space. Total: 382m2 of usable space.
Distributed in large rooms with windows facing the community common areas; the size of the windows cannot be modified, nor can access doors to the common areas be opened. Air conditioning installation via false ceiling (hot/cold), 4 bathrooms, large kitchen, 2 entrance/exit doors, 2nd door with double door and intercom. Last activity: daycare center in operation for over 30 years. THOSE INTERESTED IN CONVERTING INTO RESIDENTIAL HOUSING NEED NOT APPLY.
Premises without smoke vent.
The premises are sold as a fixed property ("cuerpo cierto"); rental is not possible. We do not have permits for a change of activity, nor do we have licenses to carry out construction work. The interested party will have to process the licenses and permits they require.
